games.name: Underwater Company
games.desc:
If you're playing on console/have a controller enabled, the game can be buggy.

A game inspired by Lethal Company combined with Subnautica. This game can be difficult at first.
IF you have trouble with a monster, read about it on the help menu!

Dive down to abandoned underwater facilities on the ocean floor to collect scrap and sell to meet the companies quota. Every time you complete the quota, your submarine dives deeper into darker and more lethal water.

Game is best played with headphones! There is a help menu in the game, if you're confused it can help you! Especially with how to avoid specific monsters.

games.name: [RELEASE] Jujutsu Odyssey
games.desc:
PLAYABLE ON MOBILE /PC /CONSOLE📱🖥️🎮

--------------------------------------------------------
As a Jujutsu Sorcerer, you’ll follow the gripping storyline, standing alongside iconic characters as you face cursed spirits, uncover ancient mysteries, and confront challenges that test your resolve. 

Your cursed technique—an extension of your spirit—shapes how you combat the darkness, whether by wielding flames that scorch the battlefield or slashing down your foes all at once. Mastery demands growth, discipline, and the courage to push your limits for the sake of humanity. 

With every battle and decision, you become a vital thread in the unfolding tale, forging a legacy of strength, loyalty, and heroism. Will you embrace your destiny as The Strongest Sorcerer of Today?
----------------------------------------

Cursed Wombs spawn every 1-2 hours under Cursed Trees, and de-spawn after 30 minutes.
